# Generated by qaff (Phase 1.9 — GitHub Actions runner).
#
# Hard rules:
#   * No secrets in this file. The workflow does not read any
#     repository or organization secrets.
#   * No Jira / Zephyr / Xray / TestRail integration. No connector is
#     called from this workflow.
#   * No external test systems. The workflow runs Maven against the
#     generated reactor only.
#   * No Azure / cloud login. Deployment: opt-in GitHub Pages publish of the
#     Allure report (ci.githubActions.pagesPublish), main branch only.
#
# Triggers:
#   * push to main  — full Maven reactor, then the pages job publishes the
#     Allure report to GitHub Pages.
#   * pull_request  — full Maven reactor (mvn -B verify).
#   * workflow_dispatch — accepts application/layer/environment/suite/
#     browser/headless inputs. When both application and layer are
#     concrete (not "all"), the workflow narrows to
#     mvn -B -pl apps/<application>/<layer> -am verify.

name: qaff-ci

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 5 * * 1-5"
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      application:
        description: "Generated application id (apps/<application>/...). Use 'all' for the full reactor."
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: all
        options: ["all", "swag-labs"]
      layer:
        description: "Generated layer for the selected application. Use 'all' for the full reactor."
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: all
        options: ["all", "web-desktop"]
      environment:
        description: "Logical environment label. Phase 1.9 does not wire any real environment."
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: local
        options: ["local", "dev", "staging"]
      suite:
        description: "JUnit 5 tag passed via -Dgroups. Leave empty to run every test."
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ""
      browser:
        description: "web-desktop browser id. Only chromium is wired today."
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: chromium
        options: ["chromium", "chrome", "firefox"]
      headless:
        description: "Run the browser headlessly (web-desktop only)."
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: "true"
        options: ["true", "false"]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    name: mvn verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"
          cache: maven

      - name: Print execution context
        run: |
          echo "event       = ${{ github.event_name }}"
          echo "application = ${{ inputs.application || 'all' }}"
          echo "layer       = ${{ inputs.layer || 'all' }}"
          echo "environment = ${{ inputs.environment || 'local' }}"
          echo "suite       = ${{ inputs.suite || '' }}"
          echo "browser     = ${{ inputs.browser || 'chromium' }}"
          echo "headless    = ${{ inputs.headless || 'true' }}"

      - name: Validate generated application/layer combination
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.application != 'all' && inputs.layer != 'all' }}
        run: |
          case "${{ inputs.application }}:${{ inputs.layer }}" in
            swag-labs:web-desktop) ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Unsupported application/layer combination: ${{ inputs.application }} / ${{ inputs.layer }}"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Run Maven verify
        env:
          # Adjust to wherever your runner has chromium installed.
          # ubuntu-latest ships /usr/bin/chromium-browser.
          BROWSER_BINARY: /usr/bin/chromium-browser
        run: |
          set -e
          APP="${{ inputs.application || 'all' }}"
          LAYER="${{ inputs.layer || 'all' }}"
          SUITE="${{ inputs.suite || '' }}"
          BROWSER="${{ inputs.browser || 'chromium' }}"
          HEADLESS="${{ inputs.headless || 'true' }}"
          MAVEN_OPTS_EXTRA=""
          if [ -n "$SUITE" ]; then
            MAVEN_OPTS_EXTRA="$MAVEN_OPTS_EXTRA -Dgroups=$SUITE"
          fi
          MAVEN_OPTS_EXTRA="$MAVEN_OPTS_EXTRA -Dbrowser.name=$BROWSER -Dbrowser.headless=$HEADLESS"
          if [ "$APP" != "all" ] && [ "$LAYER" != "all" ]; then
            MODULE="apps/$APP/$LAYER"
            echo "Building selected module: $MODULE"
            mvn -B -ntp -pl "$MODULE" -am verify $MAVEN_OPTS_EXTRA
          else
            echo "Building full Maven reactor"
            mvn -B -ntp verify $MAVEN_OPTS_EXTRA
          fi




      - name: Upload Surefire reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: surefire-reports
          path: "**/target/surefire-reports/*.xml"
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Upload Allure raw results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: allure-results
          path: "**/target/allure-results/**"
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Build Allure HTML report
        if: always()
        run: bash scripts/allure-report.sh

      - name: Upload Allure HTML report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: allure-report
          path: target/site/allure-maven-plugin/
          if-no-files-found: ignore



      # Quality Impact Pack is not enabled in this generated project,
      # so framework-performance/reports/ does not exist. Nothing to upload.

  # Opt-in Allure report publish (ci.githubActions.pagesPublish). Runs on main
  # only — also after failed tests, so a red build still publishes its report.
  # Only this job gets the Pages permissions; verify keeps contents: read.
  pages:
    name: Publish Allure report to GitHub Pages
    needs: verify
    if: ${{ always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.verify.result != 'cancelled' && needs.verify.result != 'skipped' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    concurrency:
      group: pages
      cancel-in-progress: false
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Download Allure HTML report
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: allure-report
          path: site

      - name: Configure Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v6

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        with:
          path: site

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5
